newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Transmark independent directors reject bid.
newsitem.headline: Transmark independent directors reject bid.

text.p: The independent directors of Transmark Corp Ltd on Monday rejected the $1.60 takeover offer by Gandava Investments Ltd as "inadequate" following an independent appraisal by Ernst and Young which estimated fair value for the shares at NZ$2.00-$2.15.

"Gandava's offer is not fair. The independent experts, Ernst & Young, have concluded that $2.00 to $2.15 is the fair value range for your shares. The independent directors agree with this conclusion. They recommend that shareholders should not accept the offer," directors Don Clark and Robert McGregor said.
They said the company was trading strongly and was reaping the benefits of successful restructuring.
